# Request for Proposal — Integrated Urban Development Master Plan
**Issuing Authority:** Hawassa City Administration, Urban Planning Bureau  
**Reference:** HCAUPB/RFP/2026/007  
**Deadline:** 15 August 2026, 15:00 EAT  
**Submission:** In person or registered courier, City Hall, Hawassa

## 1. Background
Hawassa City Administration seeks a qualified urban planning consultancy to prepare a 25-year Integrated Urban Development Master Plan covering land use, transport corridors, utility infrastructure, green space, and housing density zoning for the 2026–2051 planning horizon.

## 2. Scope of Services
- Baseline survey: population, land use, infrastructure inventory, environmental sensitivity
- Stakeholder consultation and community engagement (minimum 4 public hearings)
- Land use zoning map (1:5,000 scale) with regulation overlay
- Transport network plan: arterials, collectors, non-motorised transport
- Utility masterplan: water supply, drainage, solid waste, power grid
- Green and open space strategy (ICLEI-compatible indicators)
- Affordable housing density model
- Implementation action plan with phasing (5-year, 10-year, 25-year)
- Environmental and social impact screening
- GIS database delivery (QGIS format, shapefile + GeoJSON)

## 3. Required Deliverables
- Inception Report (Month 1)
- Draft Master Plan (Month 6)
- Final Master Plan + GIS Dataset (Month 9)
- Policy Brief for City Council

## 4. Required Documents
- **Technical Proposal** (separate sealed envelope)
- **Financial Proposal** (separate sealed envelope, do not include pricing in Technical envelope)
- **Company Profile** showing urban planning projects in Ethiopian cities
- **CVs** for all key experts
- **Proof of professional registration** (EiAB or EIAAB for architects)
- **VAT registration** (if applicable)
- **Tax clearance certificate**

## 5. Key Experts
| Position | Qualification | Experience |
|---|---|---|
| Team Leader / Urban Planner | MSc Urban Planning or Architecture | 12 years, 3 master plan projects |
| GIS Specialist | BSc Geography / Geomatics | 6 years |
| Transport Planner | MSc Transport Engineering | 8 years |
| Environmental Specialist | MSc Environmental Science | 6 years |
| Socio-Economic Analyst | MSc Development Studies | 5 years |

## 6. Evaluation Criteria (100 points)
| Criterion | Weight |
|---|---|
| Firm experience in urban master planning | 25 |
| Key expert qualifications and experience | 30 |
| Technical methodology and participation approach | 30 |
| Work plan and resource scheduling | 15 |

**Note:** Financial proposal is evaluated on a pass/fail basis against the approved budget ceiling.

## 7. Submission Instructions
Proposals must be submitted in two sealed envelopes clearly marked "A — Technical Proposal" and "B — Financial Proposal". Include pricing **only** in Envelope B. Submit one original and two copies of each envelope.

Contact: planning@hawassa.gov.et | +251 46 220 3344
